question: What pattern did the model reveal about past Campi Flegrei eruptions?
answer: Campi Flegrei eruptions tend to come in quasi-regular cycles. Pressure from the magma builds up slowly, an eruption releases it, and the cycle starts again. Because the rhythm repeats, the model can be used as a predictive tool.
move: Campi Flegrei eruptions come in repeating cycles of build-up and release.

web.label: A page titled Volcano Rhythm shows a sketch of eruption timing as a wavy curve, not real dates. Holding the button runs the last 60,000 years of Campi Flegrei eruptions, and the page asks what pattern the model reveals.
